versions.name: Subpixel Movement Buttons
versions.description: Move objects in increments even smaller than BetterEdit's "pixel" option

about:
# Subpixel Movement Buttons
Adds a button next to the other transform buttons in the editor that brings up a UI, with an interface that can:
- Move the current selection by 1px (This is already possible in BetterEdit)
- Move the current selection by 0.5px, 0.1px, and 0.01px
- Enter custom ranges to move with X and Y textboxes and a "Add Offset" button.

## KEEP IN MIND: 1 typical editor grid space = 30 units. HOWEVER, the "1px" button in this mod actually moves the objects by 0.1 units, just like BetterEdit.

*Note: This mod takes use of Camila314's old [UI Builder](https://github.com/camila314/uibuilder) library.
I used her [UIDesigner](mod:camila314.uidesigner) mod to generate the UI code. It was NOT made by AI.*
